title: Your First $1,000 Changes Everything
narration: Your first thousand dollars won't make you rich, but it could change how you handle money. Imagine your car suddenly breaks down, and a four-hundred-dollar repair bill lands out of nowhere. Without savings, you're reaching for a credit card, and paying for that repair long after it's fixed. But with a thousand dollars saved, that surprise doesn't have to become a financial disaster. Start small. Save twenty-five dollars a week, and that's thirteen hundred dollars in a year. Your first goal isn't to look rich. It's to stop one bad day from becoming months of debt. Start your thousand-dollar fund today.
